question: Which country secured the Uber Cup 2026 title by defeating the People's Republic of China in the final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Republic of Korea**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Republic of Korea** claimed the **Uber Cup 2026** title by defeating the **People's Republic of China** 3-1 in **Horsens, Denmark**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Republic of Korea** earned its second **Uber Cup** title in the last three stagings, beating the **People's Republic of China** 3-1 on May 3.
 
• The matches were part of the **Thomas & Uber Cup 2026**, a biennial world team championship in badminton, held in **Horsens, Denmark**.
 
• Korea's **Baek Ha Na** and **Kim Hye Jeong** sealed the victory by overcoming China's **Jia Yi Fan** and **Zhang Shu Xian** 16-21, 21-10, 21-13.
 
• Earlier, world No. 1 **An Se Young** of Korea opened the day with a win over China's **Wang Zhi Yi**, and **Kim Ga Eun** achieved an upset win over the fourth-ranked **Chen Yu Fei**.
 
• This victory marks the **Republic of Korea's** wins in the **Uber Cup** in **2010, 2022, and 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **China** was looking for a record 17th team title in the women's event, having beaten the Koreans in seven championship tilts dating back to 1988.
 
• In the men's event, the **Thomas Cup 2026** title was won by the **People's Republic of China**, who defeated **France** 3-1 in the final, marking their 13th overall win and second in a row.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The **Thomas & Uber Cup** is the biennial world team championship in badminton.
 
• **Team France** made the medal rounds of the men's event (**Thomas Cup**) for the first time in history.
